show.description: A young man embarks on a journey after tragedy destroys his home. Lost between love, loyalty, and destiny, he is drawn into an ancient sect’s battles, where powerful clans, forbidden techniques, and hidden betrayals collide. As he struggles with inner darkness and unshakable love, he must rise against fate to decide whether he becomes a savior or a demon in the legendary world of Jade Dynasty.
